team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Manage members, roles, departments, and invitations.
team.permissionBody: You don't have permission to manage this organization's team.

seats.atLimit: Seat limit reached for current plan

members.title: Members
members.intro: People with access to your organization.
members.removeNote: They will lose access immediately. You can re-invite them later.
members.conflictBody: This member was changed elsewhere. The list has been refreshed.
members.lastAdminBody: Every organization must keep at least one admin. Assign another admin first.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: Roles bundle permissions you can assign to members.
roles.name: Role name
roles.systemRoleNote: This is a system role. Its name and full-access permission can't be changed.
roles.deleteNote: Members lose this role's permissions. This can't be undone.
roles.lastAdminToast: Can't delete the last admin role
roles.lastAdminBody: At least one admin role must remain.
roles.escalationBody: You can only grant permissions you hold yourself.

departments.title: Departments
departments.intro: Organize members into teams or business units.
departments.name: Name
departments.deleteNote: Members assigned to it will be unassigned.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: Invite colleagues by email. They join after accepting.
invitations.roleHelp: Optional. Assigned automatically when they accept.
invitations.inviteBody: We'll email an invitation link valid for a limited time.
invitations.emptyBody: Invite colleagues to collaborate in your workspace.
invitations.revokeNote: The link will stop working immediately.
invitations.duplicateError: There's already a pending invitation for this email.
invitations.seatLimitError: Your organization has reached its seat limit. Upgrade your plan to invite more members.

validation.roleNameMin: Role name must be at least 2 characters.
validation.deptNameMin: Department name must be at least 2 characters.

permissions.ceilingNote: You can only grant permissions you hold yourself.
permissions.notAllowed: You don't hold this permission, so you can't grant it.

permissionPreview.title: {name}'s access
permissionPreview.hypotheticalBody: Pick roles to preview effective access before sending an invite.
permissionPreview.hypotheticalEmpty: Select at least one role to preview.

ownership.title: Organization ownership
ownership.intro: The owner has full admin control and is the organization's ultimate point of accountability.
ownership.transferWarning: This is a serious, hard-to-reverse action. The new owner will have full admin control of the organization. You keep your own admin access but will no longer be the owner.
ownership.selectMember: Select the member to receive ownership
ownership.confirmMismatch: Please type the confirmation phrase exactly.
ownership.notOwnerError: Only the current owner can transfer ownership.
ownership.targetNotActiveError: Can't transfer ownership to an inactive member.
ownership.alreadyOwnerError: This member is already the current owner.
ownership.permissionBody: You don't have permission to view organization ownership.

memberStatus.deactivateBody: Deactivate {name}'s access? You can reactivate it at any time.
memberStatus.memberLeftError: A member who has left the organization can't be deactivated or reactivated. Re-invite them instead.

auditLog.title: Activity log
auditLog.intro: History of important actions in your organization.
auditLog.permissionBody: You need the activity log permission to open this section. Ask your organization admin to grant it.
